mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 58 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. We will see an overnight low of 48 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-range vision was developed with extensive community input to prioritize housing, infrastructure, and a vibrant downtown, and you can view the full roadmap on the city website.
Today is a busy one with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza at Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus ART House 360 events start tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on October 3, officers located a 19-year-old man driving with expired registration and successfully recovered a stolen firearm from the vehicle.
While Culver's is closed for the evening, you can look forward to tomorrow when they open at 10:00 AM to serve up their flavor of the day, Double Strawberry.
